candidates.name: We Energies Rochester Lateral

values.EndLocation: Oak Creek and Elm Road Generating Station campus, Oak Creek

candidates.researcher_notes: This is a new line. It is not P8299 Lakeshore Lateral and not P2603. The Wisconsin Public Service Commission case page for docket 6630-CG-139 names the Rochester Lateral Project. It describes a new 33 mile natural gas transmission pipeline, 24 inch and 30 inch steel, from the Bluff Creek LNG facility to the Oak Creek and Elm Road generating campus, through Kenosha, Racine and Milwaukee counties. The sponsor is Wisconsin Electric Power Company Gas Operations, doing business as We Energies. The application was filed in October 2024. The commission issued a final decision on December 2, 2025. Construction was tentatively set for late 2026 with completion by the end of 2027. The case page gives cost estimates of $210,942,310 for Route A and $217,093,529 for Route B. The Route A figure is staged. Other reports give lower figures such as about $183 million. Status is proposed because construction has not started. Data center tie: the commission case page says the line serves the Oak Creek turbines and the Paris engine plant but does not mention data centers. A Canary Media article and a BizTimes article tie those plants to data center demand, but neither names the lateral (Canary calls it a new 33 mile pipeline). Because no page that names this pipeline also mentions data centers, DataCenter is left blank. A reviewer may judge the Canary article close enough. No route file was found. Two routes, A and B, were proposed and the final choice was not read. Capacity is not stated. Owner spelling follows the ownership team's gazetteer entry for Wisconsin Electric Power Co. The commission page is the only source that names the pipeline with the values. [QC] tier high -> medium (8 surviving ref(s) from 0 publisher(s); high needs at least one surviving ref).
